Home.title: African expertise. One trusted force.
Home.metadataDescription: Request an approved African technology professional or ask Umoja to help assemble a qualified expert team.
Home.introduction: Hire an approved African technology professional or ask Umoja to help assemble the expert team your work needs. Every request is qualified by people, not opened to public bidding.

trust.title: One accountable team, assembled around the work.
trust.description: Umoja is a curated delivery collective, not an anonymous freelancer directory. Each project is shaped before staffing, then delivered through clear roles, interfaces, and shared responsibility.

operating.title: A qualified path from need to engagement.
operating.description: Umoja confirms the need, the people, and the responsibility model before work begins.

steps.title: Qualify
steps.description: Share the outcome, context, timing, and constraints so Umoja can review the request responsibly.

steps.title: Match or assemble
steps.description: Umoja reviews approved expertise for one professional or a complete team; there is no public bidding.

steps.title: Confirm the model
steps.description: The parties, responsibilities, scope, and acceptance process are agreed for the specific engagement.

engagement.title: Choose the shape of support you need.
engagement.description: Both routes begin with a qualified request and keep professional contact details private.
engagement.individualDescription: Request one approved specialist for a defined individual engagement, subject to fit and agreed contract boundaries.
engagement.teamDescription: Ask Umoja to help assemble complementary expertise around a shared outcome and an approved responsibility model.

capabilities.title: Disciplines connected around the product, not sold in isolation.
capabilities.description: Umoja brings together the capabilities needed to move from discovery through dependable operation.

items.title: Product engineering
items.description: Product strategy, software architecture, web and application delivery, and long-term product stewardship.

items.title: Data and AI
items.description: Responsible data products, applied analysis, research, and automation grounded in a clear use case.

items.title: Enterprise modernization
items.description: Practical renewal of systems, workflows, and internal tools without losing essential operational context.

items.title: Cloud and operations
items.description: Reliable platforms, delivery infrastructure, observability, and operational practices built for continuity.

items.title: Design and brand
items.description: Research, service and product design, accessible interfaces, and coherent brand systems.

items.title: Digital growth
items.description: Useful content, audience strategy, experimentation, and sustainable paths from attention to adoption.

work.title: Evidence deserves consent and context.
work.description: Case studies will explain the challenge, Umoja’s contribution, the verified result, current status, and lessons—only after client and contributor approval.
work.emptyTitle: No unverified project will stand in for proof.
work.emptyDescription: The selected-work collection remains intentionally empty while historical records, outcomes, and publication permissions are reviewed.

network.title: Different roles, one connected institution.
network.description: Umoja links trusted delivery, a wider contributor network, learning and research, and independent organizations that originate meaningful work.
network.caption: Project access remains scoped to active roles and the least context needed for responsible delivery.

parts.name: Umoja Core
parts.description: Vetted contributors with broad delivery responsibility who can lead, review, mentor, and document.

parts.name: Umoja Extended
parts.description: Candidates and specialists contributing through clearly assigned modules and interfaces.

parts.name: AfricIT
parts.description: Learning, workshops, research, and public knowledge that strengthen practical capability.

parts.name: Partner organizations
parts.description: Verified independent organizations that bring work to a reusable shared workforce.

talent.title: Approved expertise, presented with consent.
talent.description: Explore moderated professional profiles without public contact details, private rates, HR records, or automatic ranking.
talent.emptyTitle: Profiles will appear after opt-in review.
talent.emptyDescription: Umoja will not create fictional specialists or expose contributor data to fill this space.

africit.title: Delivery should leave more capability behind.
africit.description: AfricIT connects practical learning, public resources, and research themes to the needs revealed through real projects and African technology markets.

manifesto.title: Build in Africa. Grow with the work.
manifesto.description: We believe meaningful digital delivery can strengthen people, organizations, and shared institutions at the same time. Umoja is being built so trusted work creates experience, experience becomes knowledge, and knowledge opens a clearer path for the next contributor.

final.title: Request expertise or contribute yours.
final.buildDescription: Choose an individual professional, a complete team, or the existing structured project journey.
final.growDescription: Apply through a private, consent-led path toward reviewed opportunities and trusted contribution.

Engagement.title: Start with the engagement your outcome needs.
Engagement.summary: Request one approved professional, ask Umoja to help assemble a complete team, or continue with a structured project brief. Every route begins with human qualification.
Engagement.individualDescription: Describe the role, outcome, context, and timing. Umoja will review approved expertise without exposing private contact details or rates.
Engagement.teamTitle: Build or request a complete team
Engagement.teamDescription: Describe the shared outcome and capability mix. Team direction and delivery responsibility will follow the approved engagement and contract model.
Engagement.projectDescription: Use the existing project-intake journey for a broader product, service, or delivery need with context, constraints, timing, and supporting files.
Engagement.boundaryDescription: Umoja does not provide public bidding, direct private contact, automatic contracting, escrow, or payouts. The parties and responsibility boundaries are agreed for each approved engagement.
Engagement.contactDescription: Hiring and project requests use the qualified intake paths. The general message form remains an explicit non-persistent preview for partnerships and other enquiries.

PublicContent.servicesSummary: Five connected capability areas, assembled around the work rather than sold in isolation.
PublicContent.servicesSectionDescription: Each category describes a responsible starting point. The final team and modules follow the actual need.

PublicContent.organizationsEmptyTitle: No organization directory is published yet.
PublicContent.organizationsEmptyDescription: Verified partner names and relationships will appear only after the organization approves publication.
